documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q2 performance was satisfying, driven by robust demand and healthy same-store sales growth, despite festive season shifts. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR 10,323 crores and consolidated profit after tax of INR 427 crores for the quarter. Management expressed high confidence in beating revenue growth targets and maintaining stable PBT margins for the upcoming second half of the fiscal year. Additionally, the regional brand ATM in Chennai has shown strong revenue traction, with plans for four more showroom launches during the current financial year. Kalyan Jewellers India Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain full-year PBT margins comparable to the previous year.
guidance.quote: So to answer your question, for the full year, I don't think there will be an impact.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its target for store openings for both Kalyan and Candere for the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of the second quarter supported by healthy same-store sales growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter on the back of very healthy same-store sales growth across most of the key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Navratri and Dhanteras started off very well with continued growth on the ground.
demand_outlook.quote: And now talking about the ongoing quarter. The quarter has started off very well, and we are very encouraged by the growth being witnessed on the ground, especially during Navratri and Dhanteras.

demand_outlook.claim: For the first 40 days of the ongoing quarter, performance has been excellent with visible volume growth.
demand_outlook.quote: And as we speak, for the first 40 days it has been excellent and we have seen volume growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that on-ground demand remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. The demand on ground is strong. It continues like Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of the quarter except for one month of Adhik-Maas.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter, except for 1 month of. Adhik-Maas.

demand_outlook.claim: Management is upbeat about the upcoming festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We are upbeat about the upcoming festive and wedding season and are fully geared up with fresh collections and campaigns.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its regional brand ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai in August.
capex_expansion.quote: As you are aware, we launched our regional brand, ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai during the month of August.

capex_expansion.claim: Plans are drawn up to launch the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The first showroom of the regional brand ATM will be launched on August 21st in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: The first showroom will be launched on 21st August in Chennai and shall be followed by another four showrooms in the next coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open 50 showrooms for Candere during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: And again, to add 50 showrooms in Candere. That is the plan for the financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Old gold exchange is margin dilutive by around 0.2% to 0.3%.
margins_costs.quote: And you know that exchange itself is margin dilutive by around 0.2% -0.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Cash for gold is a new product that is highly margin accretive compared to exchange.
margins_costs.quote: Which is highly margin accretive when compared to exchange.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's non-GML debt is fully repaid, and 50 percent of the collateral has been released.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it is debt-free non-GML now, as you mentioned, and 50% of the collateral is already out of which we have sold one land parcel of INR86 crores, INR87 crores, and INR16 crores to be done on the ongoing quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flows will predominantly be utilized to strengthen existing showrooms requiring more inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: But yes, the cash flow, predominantly, we want to utilize to strengthen our existing showrooms where certain showrooms need more inventory to drive more SSGs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has signed agreements for two parcels of land with an aggregate consideration of around INR102 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We have signed the agreement with potential buyers for 2 separate parcels of land with an aggregate consideration amount to around INR102 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects to conclude the sale process and receive consideration for land parcels before the end of the ongoing quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We expect to conclude the sale process and receive consideration before the end of the ongoing quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is on track to complete non-GML debt repayment by the end of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp rise in international oil prices and resulting forex pressure led to the launch of the Shine with India gold recirculation campaign.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sharp rise in international oil prices and the resultant pressure on forex led us to launch our "Shine with India" gold recirculation campaign.

management_commitments.claim: Four more ATM showrooms will be launched during the current financial year, with two in the ongoing quarter and two in the fourth quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company does not have immediate plans to launch ATM in another state for at least a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue only in Tamil Nadu because it has to shape up in one state, and which will at least take a couple of years. So no more immediate plans to go to another state.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to maintain the share of recycled gold in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.
management_commitments.quote: and our efforts will be to maintain the share in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.

management_commitments.claim: The company will complete non-GML debt repayment by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
